inference.decision__DecisionInput.description:
The input for the `decision` task.
Either a string, or an object. The object form additionally allows specifying images.
The `decision` task currently only supports the `text` and `image` types.

questions.description:
The questions to answer, keyed by question name. The answers in the response use the same names.
The questions replace the ones of the inference endpoint as a whole. At least one question is required.

inference.decision__DecisionTaskSettings.description: The task settings of the `decision` task.

inference.decision__DecisionQuestion.description:
A question answered by the `decision` task.
The type of the question determines the type of its answer.

instructions.description: A description of what to decide. It must not be empty.

inference.decision__PredicateDecisionQue.description: A question answered with the probability that the statement in `instructions` is true.

instructions.description: A description of what to decide. It must not be empty.

choices.description: The options to choose from, each mapped to an optional description. At least two choices are required.

inference.decision__ChoiceDecisionQuesti.description: A question answered with one option out of a fixed set of choices.

instructions.description: A description of what to decide. It must not be empty.

levels.description: The levels of the scale, ordered from lowest to highest. At least two levels are required.

inference.decision__ScoreDecisionQuestio.description: A question answered with the probability-weighted position on an ordered scale of levels.

inference.decision__DecisionScoreLevel.description: A level of a `score` question: either a plain label, or an object with a label and an optional description.
